comparison: The slope-fibre call targets the one-match covariance (Round 178/180 normalization, target O(p^(3/2))). The first-mass call targets M_w=sum_s w(s)P_s for the whole positive diagonal, which closes only the J in {0,1} classes. Both lie in the ordinary positive-completion route but concern different sums: the one-match covariance is a correlation of the twisted physical interior H_alpha across outputs, while M_w is a first moment of the positive diagonal; neither bound implies the other at the stated scales. The cold call concerns coordinate delocalization of the marked Picard prefix and shares no estimate with the ordinary calls. No earlier call is active.
